mappings.note: Full match of the superscription.
Direct translation of 'I love you, O Lord'.
List of metaphors (rock, fortress, etc.) matches exactly.
Calling upon the Lord and being saved from enemies.
Cords of death and torrents of Belial match OSMAIN v5.
Cords of Sheol and snares of death match OSMAIN v6.
Distress cry heard in the temple matches OSMAIN v7.
Earth quaking and foundations shaking match OSMAIN v8.
Smoke from nostrils and fire from mouth match OSMAIN v9.

OSMAIN includes 'He bowed the heavens' which is present in WLC. However, OSMAIN adds 'with dark clouds under his feet'. The Hebrew (WLC) says 'and darkness was under his feet'. This is a semantic match, but strictly speaking, the phrasing differs slightly ('darkness' vs 'clouds'). Let's re-evaluate: v10 in WLC is 'He bowed the heavens and came down; thick clouds were under his feet.' OSMAIN v10 says 'Han bøyde himmelen og steg ned, med mørke skyer under sine føtter'. This is an exact match.
Riding on a cherub and flying with wind wings matches OSMAIN v11.
Darkness as hiding place/tent around him matches OSMAIN v12.
Brightness before Him causing hail and coals to pass through clouds matches OSMAIN v13.
Thunder from heaven and the Most High giving voice match OSMAIN v14.
Sending arrows/scattering them and lightning causing confusion matches OSMAIN v15.
Water channels revealed and foundations of the world laid bare match OSMAIN v16.
Reaching down from on high to draw out of great waters matches OSMAIN v17.
Delivered from mighty enemy and those who hated him match OSMAIN v18.
Meeting on the day of trouble; Lord as support matches OSMAIN v19.
Brought out into a broad place because He delighted in him matches OSMAIN v20.
Rewarded according to righteousness and cleanness of hands matches OSMAIN v21.
Kept the ways of the Lord and did not act wickedly match OSMAIN v22.
Judgments before eyes; statutes not cast off matches OSMAIN v23.
Perfect with Him and kept from sin matches OSMAIN v24.
Returned to me according to righteousness/cleanness before His eyes matches OSMAIN v25.
With the faithful you show yourself faithful; with the blameless blameless match OSMAIN v26.
With the pure pure; with the crooked perverse matches OSMAIN v27.
Saving a humble people and humbling haughty eyes match OSMAIN v28.
Lighting the lamp; God lighting up darkness matches OSMAIN v29.
Running against a troop and leaping over walls match OSMAIN v30.
God's way perfect; word tested; shield for those who take refuge matches OSMAIN v31.
Who is God but the Lord? Who a rock except our God? Matches OSMAIN v32.
God girding with strength and making way perfect matches OSMAIN v33.
Feet like hinds; standing on high places match OSMAIN v34.
Teaching hands to war; arms bending a bronze bow matches OSMAIN v35.
Shield of salvation; right hand supporting; meekness making great match OSMAIN v36.
Making room for steps; ankles not slipping matches OSMAIN v37.
Pursuing enemies and overtaking them until destroyed match OSMAIN v38.
Crushing so they cannot rise; falling under feet matches OSMAIN v39.
Girding with strength for war; bringing adversaries to knees match OSMAIN v40.
Enemies turning back; destroying those who hate matches OSMAIN v41.
Crying for help with no savior; crying to Lord but not answered match OSMAIN v42.
Grinding like dust/wind; pouring out as mire in streets matches OSMAIN v43.
WLC v44 contains 'You deliver me from the strife of peoples; you set me as head over nations. A people I did not know serve me.' OSMAIN v44 matches this exactly.
Hearing and obeying; strangers submitting match OSMAIN v45.
Strangers wasting away and trembling from fortresses matches OSMAIN v46.
The Lord lives; blessed be my rock; exalted God of salvation match OSMAIN v47.
God giving vengeance and subduing peoples matches OSMAIN v48.
WLC v49: 'Deliverer from my enemies; exalted above adversaries; saved me from a man of violence.' OSMAIN v49 matches this content exactly.
WLC v50: 'Therefore I will thank you among the nations and sing to your name.' OSMAIN v50 starts with this but continues.
WLC v51: 'He gives great victories to his king and shows steadfast love to his anointed, to David and his offspring forever.' This is the second half of OSMAIN v50.

extraContent.description: OSMAIN verse 50 contains additional text ('He gives great victories to his king...') that corresponds to WLC verse 51. The mapping for WLC v50 is only the first part of OSMAIN v50.
This verse exists in the translation (WLC) but represents a split from OSMAIN verse 50. It does not contain content outside the scope of OSMAIN's text, it is just numbered differently.
